summary: Admit the read-only Wildberries advertising runtime and its provider-neutral facts, P&L projection, reconciliation evidence and UI without enabling campaign writes.

impacts.evidence: Campaigns, facts, findings and sync runs use authenticated organization/workspace scope and forced PostgreSQL RLS; provider account IDs are never a tenant override.
Only bounded campaign/fact fields, IDs, amounts, timestamps and quality are retained; tokens, raw provider responses and unnecessary PII are excluded.
Advertising campaigns, spend, performance, metrics, reconciliation and sync-run operations are additive OpenAPI paths with regenerated SDKs.
MVP persists normalized facts and findings; it does not introduce an unimplemented advertising event or bypass the EventBus/outbox boundary.
AdvertisingReader and typed advertising operation contracts are additive Connector SDK interfaces; provider-specific fields remain adapter-owned.
Expand-only migration 47 adds tenant-scoped campaign, fact, finding and sync-run tables with catalog checksum and backup requirement.
ads.read is default-deny at account and API boundaries; secrets are callback-scoped and raw Authorization/provider bodies never enter logs or evidence.
The MVP has no advertising write route. Budget, bid, status and product mutations remain deferred until approval, cap, idempotency and unknown-result qualification.
Sync runs, source references, quality and reconciliation findings provide bounded evidence without rewriting source financial records.
Remote account/fact/period identities are deduplicated, API spend takes precedence over old copies in P&L input, and unattributed/delayed facts remain visible.
Only fixed official WB advertising read endpoints are called through the built-in connector transport; no webhook ingress or arbitrary host is added.
Daily sync watermarks, status/error codes, bounded pages and reconciliation findings expose freshness and delayed/unattributed data without secret logging.
Migration 47 is high-risk expand-only and backup-gated; rollback is ads.read disablement and worker drain, without destructive down migration.
Core, connector, API parity, migration catalog, generated SDK, worker, frontend build and Docker qualification checks cover the admitted read boundary.
